name: The Flesh Is Weak
oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them are artifacts in addition to their other types.
Nonartifact creatures get -1/-1.

needs.what: a layer-7c `buff` static whose `affects` filter (`not_types: ["Artifact"]`) reads a creature's card types after layer 4, so a creature made an artifact by another static (here this card's own `add_subtype` with `types: ["Artifact"]` and `has_counters: "+1/+1"`) is excluded from the -1/-1
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The other two lines are expressible (self_enters add_counters over creatures you control; an add_subtype static adding the Artifact card type to creatures you control with has_counters "+1/+1"), but `_matches_printed` answers `not_types` from the printed `card.types`, and the `derived` read off `chars` is allowed only for rule-modifying statics (attacks_if_able, block_restriction), not for buff inside the layer pipeline. Written with the existing filter, every printed nonartifact creature -- including the ones this card just made artifacts -- would get -1/-1, which inverts the card's whole point
